content: Table TABREF17 (bottom) shows that GreenCovidSQuADBERT outperforms general-domain SQuADBERT in all metrics. Most of the improvement can be achieved with just the small CORD-19 corpus, which is more specific to the target domain (compare “Cord-19 only” and “Cord-19+PubMed+PMC”).
